fullDesc: Description: This is an engaging, hands-on science experiment kit designed to introduce children to the fundamentals of magnetism and basic physical science through fun, interactive play. Marketed as a "科普实验工具" (popular science experiment tool), the set combines several classic magnetism-based demonstrations into one compact, blister-packed kit, making it an ideal educational toy for curious young learners, classroom science activities, or STEM-focused gift sets. The kit includes a small magnetic toy car built with alternating red and blue magnetic segments, designed to demonstrate magnetic attraction and repulsion in a simple, visual way as children experiment with how the magnets interact. It also includes a functional compass with a rotating dial marked in degrees, allowing kids to learn the basics of magnetic north-south orientation and how compasses work — a simple but effective introduction to Earth's magnetism. What's included, and what each piece does: Magnetic Toy Car — A small wheeled car with red and blue magnetic blocks attached to its sides. The color-coding (red = one pole, blue = the opposite pole) helps kids visually understand magnetic polarity — how like poles repel and opposite poles attract. Compass — A real, functional compass with directional markings (N, S, E, W, and degree markings from 0–360). This teaches how magnetism is used in real-world navigation, since a compass needle aligns with the Earth's natural magnetic field. Two Steel Ball Bearings — Silver metal balls that are attracted to magnets. Kids can use these with the magnetic car or compass area to observe and test magnetic pull firsthand. Bottle of Iron Filings — Fine iron powder/shavings sealed in a small bottle with a dropper-style red cap. When a magnet is placed near or under the bottle, the filings shift and arrange themselves — making invisible magnetic field lines visible. Star-Shaped Magnetic Pad — A flat, star-shaped rubber or plastic mat that likely serves as a base or holder for the magnets and experiments, possibly with magnetic properties itself for testing polarity. Purpose: This kit is meant to let children see and touch magnetism in action rather than just reading about it — reinforcing concepts like attraction, repulsion, magnetic fields, and compass navigation through simple, safe experiments. Best suited for: Elementary-aged children, science classrooms...

fullDesc: Description: This is a smart human-body infrared (PIR) sensing LED downlight, designed for recessed ceiling installation. The unit features a built-in Passive Infrared (PIR) sensor module (visible as the central dome on the fixture face) that detects body heat and movement, triggering the light automatically without requiring a manual switch. It includes an adjustable delay timer that keeps the light on for a set duration after motion is last detected, and operates on universal AC mains input, making it compatible with both 110V and 220V electrical systems worldwide. The housing is a slim, round, flush-mount downlight design with a cutout-style trim for ceiling installation, pre-wired with a two-conductor lead for direct connection to mains wiring. fullDesc: Description: The PD020065EP_G is a Silicon Carbide (SiC) Schottky barrier diode rated for 650V and 20A, packaged in a 2-lead TO-220-2 through-hole outline with a metal mounting tab for heatsinking. As a wide-bandgap SiC device, it offers substantial performance advantages over conventional silicon rectifiers — most notably, near-zero reverse recovery charge, which dramatically reduces switching losses in high-frequency circuits. Because of its temperature-independent switching behavior and negligible reverse recovery, this diode is particularly well suited to power factor correction (PFC) stages, boost converters, and other hard-switching power topologies where a standard silicon diode would introduce significant losses and heat. Its high forward surge current capability and stable performance at elevated junction temperatures (up to 175°C) make it a reliable choice for demanding power electronics designs. The TO-220-2 package is a compact, non-isolated through-hole outline with a metal tab for direct heatsink mounting, ideal for moderate-to-high power applications where efficient thermal management is required. Key Specifications: Type: Silicon Carbide (SiC) Schottky Barrier Diode Device Marking: PD020065EP_G Reverse Voltage (VRRM): 650V Forward Current (IF): 20A Reverse Recovery Charge: Near-zero (negligible Qrr) Max Junction Temperature: 175°C Package Type: TO-220-2 (2-Pin, Through Hole, Non-Isolated Tab) Applications: Power factor correction (PFC), boost/DC-DC converters, switch-mode power supplies (SMPS), solar inverters, uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), and industrial motor drives. Package Includes: 1 x PD020065EP_G SiC Schottky Diode (TO-220-2)

fullDesc: Description: The SFF1606G is a high-current, glass-passivated super-fast rectifier diode, manufactured by Taiwan Semiconductor Corporation (TSC). Internally, the device is built as a diode array with a common-cathode configuration — two fast-recovery diode elements sharing a common cathode connection, useful for center-tap rectification in power supply designs. Rated for 400V and capable of handling 16A, this rectifier is built for high-efficiency, low-loss power conversion. It offers a low forward voltage drop, fast switching (recovery times as low as ~35ns), high surge current capability, and high overall reliability — making it well suited for demanding industrial, automotive, and power supply applications. The part is UL Recognized, RoHS compliant, and halogen-free, with AEC-Q101 automotive-qualified variants also available. The device comes in a TO-220F (isolated tab) package , allowing it to be mounted directly to a heatsink without a separate insulating pad — helpful for compact designs with multiple high-current rectifiers mounted close together. Key Specifications: Manufacturer: Taiwan Semiconductor Corporation (TSC) Part Number: SFF1606G Type: Super Fast Rectifier Diode Array (Common Cathode) Reverse Voltage (VRRM): 400V Forward Current (IF): 16A Forward Voltage Drop (VF): ~1.3V @ 16A Reverse Recovery Time (trr): ~35ns Package Type: TO-220F / ITO-220AB (3-Pin, Isolated, Through Hole) Certifications: UL Recognized, RoHS Compliant, Halogen-Free Applications: Switch-mode power supplies (SMPS), freewheeling and flyback rectification, industrial power conversion, automotive electronics, and general high-current, high-speed rectification circuits. Package Includes: 1 x SFF1606G Super Fast Rectifier Diode (TO-220F)

fullDesc: Description: The KIA7818A is a three-terminal positive fixed voltage regulator manufactured by KEC (Korea Electronics Corporation), designed to output a stable, regulated 18V from an unregulated DC input. Part of KEC's 78xx-series regulator family, it's built for straightforward, drop-in voltage regulation in a wide range of analog and digital circuits, including C-MOS, TTL, DTL, and HTL power supply applications. The device includes internal thermal overload protection and internal short-circuit current limiting, making it robust against overheating and output faults during operation. It can supply an output current in excess of 1A, and requires only minimal external components (typically a couple of capacitors) to function reliably in a circuit. This particular unit is housed in a TO-220F (isolated) package — a fully-insulated variant of the standard TO-220 outline, allowing direct mounting to a heatsink without a separate insulating pad, which simplifies board assembly while keeping the mounting tab electrically isolated from the circuit. Key Specifications: Manufacturer: KEC (Korea Electronics) Part Number: KIA7818A Type: Fixed Positive Voltage Regulator Output Voltage: 18V Output Current: Up to 1A (1.5A on some variants) Package Type: TO-220F (3-Pin, Isolated, Through Hole) Protection Features: Internal thermal overload protection, internal short-circuit current limiting Equivalent To: NTE1974 Applications: General-purpose 18V DC power regulation, on-board voltage regulation for logic families (C-MOS, TTL, DTL, HTL), power supplies, and embedded electronic systems requiring a stable 18V rail. Package Includes: 1 x KEC KIA7818A Voltage Regulator (TO-220F)

fullDesc: Description: The MBRF30100C is a dual Schottky barrier power rectifier housed in a full-plastic, isolated TO-220F (ITO-220AB) package. It consists of two Schottky diode elements internally connected in a common-cathode configuration, allowing it to function as a center-tap rectifier for dual-output or full-wave rectification stages in power supplies. Built on metal-silicon junction (Schottky) technology, this device offers a notably low forward voltage drop and fast switching response compared to standard silicon rectifiers — translating into lower power dissipation and higher overall efficiency. It's rated to handle high surge currents and is well suited to high-frequency switching environments where conduction losses need to be minimized. The isolated TO-220F package means the mounting tab is electrically separated from the internal circuitry, so the part can be bolted directly to a heatsink without needing a separate insulating mica pad — simplifying assembly while maintaining safe electrical isolation. Key Specifications: Type: Dual Schottky Barrier Rectifier (Common Cathode) Device Marking: MBRF30A0C Peak Reverse Voltage (VRRM): 100V Average Forward Current (IF): 30A total (15A per diode) Forward Voltage Drop (VF): ~0.85V typical Package Type: TO-220F / ITO-220AB (3-Pin, Isolated, Through Hole) Max Junction Temperature: 150°C Configuration: 2-Pin diode + common tab (2+Tab) Applications: Switch-mode power supply (SMPS) output rectification, DC-DC converter freewheeling diodes, center-tap rectification, reverse polarity protection, and general power rectification in industrial and consumer electronics. fullDesc: Description: The NCE65T180F is an N-Channel Super Junction Power MOSFET manufactured by NCE Power Semiconductor, built using advanced trench-gate super junction technology. This design delivers excellent low on-resistance and low conduction losses, along with an ultra-low gate charge that reduces driving requirements and improves overall switching performance. Rated at 650V, this MOSFET is engineered to meet the demanding needs of AC-DC switch-mode power supplies (SMPS), making it well-suited for power factor correction (PFC), AC/DC power conversion, and general industrial power applications. It is 100% avalanche tested for ruggedness and is fully RoHS compliant. The device is housed in a TO-220F (fully insulated) package , which allows direct mounting to a heatsink without requiring a separate insulating pad — a practical advantage in compact, high-density power supply designs. fullDesc: Description: The MC7805ABT is a 3-terminal positive fixed voltage regulator manufactured by ON Semiconductor, designed to deliver a stable, regulated 5V output. It's a monolithic integrated circuit built for local, on-card power regulation, making it a staple component in countless electronic circuits and power supply designs. This regulator features built-in protection circuitry including internal current limiting, thermal shutdown, and safe-operating-area compensation, which makes it essentially indestructible under most overload conditions. It requires only a couple of external capacitors to function, making it extremely simple to implement in a design. The device comes in the TO-220 package , a widely-used through-hole format with a metal tab for heatsink mounting, ideal for applications where moderate heat dissipation is expected during voltage regulation. fullDesc: Product Highlights This is ESP32 Bruce — an Open-Source firmware based on ESP32 hardware, specifically designed for Red Team operations in the field of network security, providing a range of offensive security testing capabilities. Its main uses include conducting penetration testing and security assessments for various wireless communication methods. Use the CYD Bruce to unlock Flipper-Zero-like features on the ESP32 2432S028 device. This board comes flashed with ESP32-Bruce 1.9.1 firmware on the Cheap Yellow Display, offering powerful WiFi and Bluetooth testing features on an affordable and accessible hardware platform. With the CYD Bruce, you can easily work with WiFi, BLE, Sub-GHz module (CC1101), NFC (PN532), GPS (ATGM336H / NEO-6M), IR, and more — a powerful platform for exploration. Hardware Compatibility The Bruce firmware is compatible with the Cheap Yellow Display ecosystem and development boards similar to CYD. USB-C and Micro-USB Ports , Micro-SD card slot, acrylic case. CYD (Cheap Yellow Display) with 2.8″, 240×380 touch screen , driver chip ST7789. Power via laptop, phone charger, or power bank. Functions with or without an SD card — SD card required to save your work. More Information Bruce Firmware GitHub: https://github.com/pr3y/Bruce Module Setup Guide (GPS, NFC, IR, RF, CC1101, NRF24 & Speaker): YouTube Tutorial Important Notice This listing is for ESP32 Bruce , not NMMiner.
